decomposition.name: Coque supérieure et flancs rouge WEWA
decomposition.construction_to_prepare: Smooth broad upper crown and shoulders, lateral knee relief and rounded front; distinguish upper curvature from lower return. Longitudinal and transverse sections required, not sphere/ellipsoid substitution.
decomposition.critical_unknowns: Section widths/heights, asymmetry, sheet thickness, exact plane of lower seam, actual millimetres.

decomposition.name: Coque inférieure, tunnel et jonction périphérique
decomposition.construction_to_prepare: Separate lower pan, tunnel and perimeter seam only after identity/underside documentation.
decomposition.critical_unknowns: Tunnel entire section/depth, internal seam, welds, wall thickness, fuel-sender mounting and clearance toframe. No acceptable target underside.

decomposition.name: Bouche de remplissage et portée du bouchon
decomposition.construction_to_prepare: Circular metal neck within a local shaped seat, plus two visible small nearby openings; functions of these holes are conditional against D04, not inferred blindly.
decomposition.critical_unknowns: Neck diameter/height, precise off-axis position, internal seating, top surface depression and hole spacing. No mm from photo.

decomposition.name: Bouchon, charnière, serrure, retenue et joints
decomposition.construction_to_prepare: Metal upper cap curved in both directions, hinge and key aperture separate; hidden latch/seals unresolved.
decomposition.critical_unknowns: Exact currentpartnumber, thickness, hinge travel, keyslot contour and undersurface. No complete underside image.

decomposition.name: Brides et oreilles de la coque
decomposition.construction_to_prepare: Rear terminal flange with elongated opening and a downward pierced ear actually visible on related detachedpart. Separate from body surface; flange relationship to currentframe not certified.
decomposition.critical_unknowns: Oppositeear, front underside cups and lugpositions, weld/bend sections, functionalassignment of lateral ear. Do not call every hole a chassis tank mount.

decomposition.name: Appuis avant et arrière, rondelle et goupille
decomposition.construction_to_prepare: Front grooved cylindrical rubber and rear rectangular profiled pad are discrete parts; frame abutments and fitting orientation remain unresolved.
decomposition.critical_unknowns: Dimensions, actual hidden socket/cup, fittedcompression, rear through-interface and exactRDCfitment. No tag/packaging size as a ruler.

decomposition.name: Robinet, sortie, durite et fixation inférieure
decomposition.construction_to_prepare: Separate tap assembly and hose, function ON/RES/OFF from related manuals.
decomposition.critical_unknowns: Currenttapidentity, undersideposition, flangeprofile, outletorientation and hiddenpassages; do not transfer D15tap to D04orcurrent automatically.

decomposition.name: Jauge, joint et câblage éventuels
decomposition.construction_to_prepare: Reserve candidate sensor envelope as unknown. D15 shows four-nut flange; D04 lists an O-ring but no complete sensor geometry.
decomposition.critical_unknowns: CurrentRDC sender identity, access hole shape and exactposition. Fuel gauge onbike does not prove D15flange.

decomposition.name: Marquage WEWA et finition
decomposition.construction_to_prepare: Create original WEWA graphics after shellshape, UVandproportions. Use glossy red / cinematic realism as target, not newunlicensedphototexture.
decomposition.critical_unknowns: Paint/clearcoat measured spectra, filmthickness and exact roughness; lightingreflections are not albedotexture.
